Title: BlackNevas ESXi ransomware - ipv4
Description: Remote-management (MeshAgent) C2 server the BlackNevas operator used to return to the compromised vCenter appliance and install the Ligolo-ng tunnel. Source: Kaspersky GERT (Securelist) – Ransomware at the hypervisor layer: how attackers use ESXi and vCenter features for malicious purposes https://securelist.com/esxi-ransomware/121959/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
